## Crucible Devil (Sculmynus) (CR 19)

This hulking, hunched devil is encased in a thick breastplate and wields a star-shaped axe. It lets a bellowing laugh out of its goateed face, its horns waving menacingly.  


**XP** 204,800  
LE Huge outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness; Perception +29;  


**Defense**


**AC** 37, touch 12, flat-footed 33 (+7 armor, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +18 natural, –2 size)  
**hp** 313 (19d10+209); regeneration 5 (good weapons, good spells)  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +16, **Will** +18  
**DR** 15/good and silver; **Immune** disease, fire, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10; **SR** 30  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft. (40 ft. unarmored)  
**Melee** +1 flaming burst unholy staraxe +31/+26/+21/+16 (3d8+19/x3 plus 1d6 fire and grab) and gore +24 (2d8+6) or 2 slams +29 (2d6+12), gore +29 (2d8+12)  
**Space** 15 ft., **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** break limb, dimensional pull  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 19th; concentration +25)  


At will—air walk, arcane sight, dimensional anchor, fireball (DC 19), greater dispel magic, greater teleport, hold monster (DC 21), invisibility, magic circle against good, major curse (DC 21) scorching ray, wall of fire  

3/day—blasphemy (DC 23), delayed blast fireball (DC 23), greater hostile juxtaposition (DC 23), hellfire ray, true seeing, unholy aura (DC 24)  

1/day—meteor swarm (DC 25), summon (level 8, 2 horned devils, 80%)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 35, **Dex** 16, **Con** 31, **Int** 25, **Wis** 24, **Cha** 22  
**Base Atk** +19; **CMB** +33 (+37 grapple); **CMD** 47  
**Feats** Cleave, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Furious Focus, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (staraxe), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Lightning Reflexes.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +22, Appraise +26, Bluff +28, Diplomacy +25, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (arcana, planes, religion) +28, Perception +29, Sense Motive +29, Spellcraft +26, Stealth +17, Use Magic Device +25  
**Languages** Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** infernal transport, reclaim quintessence  


**Special Abilities**


**Break Limb (Ex)** A crucible devil can catch enemy limbs between the struts of its staraxe. This works as a grab special attack, with the crucible devil being able to both initiate and maintain grapple with its staraxe. When a crucible devil succeeds at a grapple check to maintain grapple and deal damage using its staraxe, it can also attempt to break one of its opponent’s limbs. The targeted creature must succeed at a DC 31 Fortitude save or have one of its limbs wrenched and broken, affecting the creature as if it failed a save against the wither limb spell. The save DC is Strength-based.  

**Dimensional Pull (Su)** A crucible devil can teleport a single creature within 100 feet to itself as a standard action. The targeted creature must succeed at a DC 25 Will save or be teleported to an empty space adjacent to the crucible devil, chosen by the devil. If a creature fails this save and is teleported, it is also dazed until the beginning of its turn, disoriented by the sudden extradimensional movement. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Infernal Transport (Su)** A crucible devil can transport itself through planar shortcuts, appearing to be swallowed into a pit in a burst of fire and smoke, only to reappear somewhere else in an instant. This works as a dimension door, except using it is a move action and the crucible devil may use any remaining actions after using this ability.  

**Reclaim Quintessence (Su)** A crucible devil can, as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, mold quintessence of an adjacent outsider’s body into new, living devils. A crucible devil can make any combination of non-unique devils using this ability, although those devils cannot have more Hit Dice than a quarter of those of the originating outsider. This limit is doubled when used on dead devils. For example, a crucible devil could transform a balor’s body into an imp and a lemure or a single gambling devil. If used on a dead pit fiend, this ability could result in 5 lemures, 2 gambling devils or a bone devil instead, or any valid combination of lesser devils. Any unused Hit Dice are lost, and the new devil is created with full hit points. This ability does not work on outsiders that have been dead for more than 10 minutes.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any (Hell)  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or assembly (3-6)  
**Treasure** standard (+1 flaming burst unholy staraxe, +1 breastplate, other treasure)
